qualification_limits: SOURCE_ONLY_CANDIDATE; independent review and separate ledger promotion required.

No source/repository/ledger mutation, children, project helper/scanner/parser, Go/test/build/runtime/process probe/cloud/signing/crypto/TerraBase execution. Ordinary pinned reading and metadata hashing/serialization only.

Actual boundary credit is limited to temporary filesystem failure/persistence/lifetime behavior. Protocol golden-file reads and qualification ready-log/credential existence/event logging are incidental where the asserted target remains local crypto/schema/clock/argv logic.
